items.source: Return the AspectJPrecedenceInformation provided by this advisor or its advice. If neither the advisor nor the advice have precedence information, this method will return null.
items.translation: 返回此顾问或其建议提供的 AspectJPrecedenceInformation。如果该顾问或建议均无优先级信息，则此方法将返回null。
